headline: 2019 Porsche 911 Speedster is Now Available at duPont REGISTRY Select!
overview: The Speedster is a send-off for the 991 generation. It features the iconic low windshield, double-hump rear deck, manual soft top and lightweight bucket seats, and is powered by the high-revving 4.0L flat six paired with a precise 6-speed manual transmission. This Speedster is among the most desirable modern 911s, blending track-ready performance and open-air driving enjoyment.
